messages:
Raj (Marketing): Quick kickoff: need a compact creative bundle for the benchmark webinar next Tue. Deliverables: 1 hero banner (web), 4 social squares (IG/Twitter), a single-slide benchmark snapshot (for slide deck + LP), and two short CTA designs for the registration modal. Aim to keep assets repurposeable across paid/social. First drafts in 36h, final by Wednesday EOD.
Mia (Design): Clear. Who's the audience and the single metric to push on hero? Any legal/partner constraints?
Priya (Content): Audience = platform/infra engineers and engineering managers. Core metric to lead with = p50 latency improvement vs baseline. Secondary: cost savings per 1k tokens. Tone = technical, confident, non-salesy.
Tessa (Demand Gen): Routing: CTA A -> /register?form=web; CTA B -> /resources?form=case. Add utm_source=bench_launch utm_medium=social utm_campaign=webinar_apr. Hidden field form.flow=mini-bench. Short CTA copy for socials (max 45 chars).
Alex (Brand): Use brand tokens only. Accent = --brand-accent-2 (falls back to #0091EA). BG palette: neutral-50 and neutral-10. Logos: horizontal mark only on dark backgrounds, stacked on light. No partner logos in this batch. Accessibility: color contrast >=4.5 for numeric values.
Mia (Design): Export specs request:
```
hero: 1200x628 PNG 2x + webp
social squares: 1080x1080 PNG 2x
slide snapshot: 1440x900 PDF + PPTX export (single slide)
sparklines: inline SVG + 2x PNG
font: Inter var, numbers as separate layers
```
Mia (Design): Also want the raw CSV for sparklines and a short 1-2 bullet annotation for each datapoint (so copy can be embedded in the graphic).
Raj (Marketing): Luca already pulled the numbers; Priya can you write the two bullets per datapoint?
Priya (Content): Yep. I'll draft bullets: 1) p50 latency down 40% after serving optimizations; 2) throughput increased 2.6x under steady-state; 3) per-unit serving cost down 29%. Posting drafts here in 2h.
Tessa (Demand Gen): For social we need 2 CTA treatments: concise CTA + small subline. Also request 3 variants of the hero headline so we can A/B test.
Mia (Design): Understood. I'll mock hero A/B headlines into the Figma file. Please sanity-check headline length (desktop+mobile).
DesignBot: Figma draft created: https://figma.com/file/def456/mini-bench-sprint (page: launch-assets). Auto-export folder: /design/mini-bench/apr-launch.
Alex (Brand): Uploaded updated color tokens to the figma file. Reminder: avoid drop shadows on number badges; use flat ring.
Mia (Design): Small question on microcopy placement: should the cost metric appear next to latency or as a separate badge?
Raj (Marketing): Put latency as primary on hero, cost as a smaller badge under it. Social tiles can alternate emphasis.
Priya (Content): Posting copy variants for hero and social:
- Hero short: "Serving wins: 40% lower median latency"
- Hero long: "Serving optimizations reduced median latency by 40% — live demo + benchmarks"
- Social CTA short: "See the benchmark" / subline "Live webinar, Apr 10"
- Social CTA alt: "Watch the serving demo" / subline "Benchmarks + Q&A"

Priya (Content): Also adding en-GB spellcheck variants (colour vs color notes in non-core text only).
Mia (Design): Great, grabbing the copy. Will push two hero mockups + one social carousel in 36h.
Tessa (Demand Gen): Reminder: tracking needs data-layer hooks for form.hidden.form.flow & utm. Also add conversion pixel placeholder for paid channels.
Alex (Brand): Legal double-checked the claims. Keep language "up to" only when the dataset varies; otherwise use absolute numbers we can prove. Priya, mark which lines are absolute vs up-to.
Priya (Content): Will tag absolute vs up-to in the copy doc.
Mia (Design): Quick dev note: please confirm if we need retina export for slide PNGs (2x). I'll include both 1x + 2x by default.
Raj (Marketing): Yes include 1x + 2x. Also push an SVG hero for web embedding.
DesignBot: Reminder set: design review in 24 hours.
Mia (Design): OK will post Figma links + export zip here when drafts are ready. Tagging Raj & Tessa for review. :tada:
